title: Zodiac crash retrieval program
summary: UAPGerb tells of Zodiac crash retrieval program, about 1998 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in 1998 um UFO magazine published a story uh by a pseudonym Greg Halifax about Sedge Masters a a story about somebody who is brought into a UFO crash retrieval program called Zodiac.

plain: A commentator who goes by UAPGerb says that in 1998 a publication called UFO Magazine ran a story by a writer using the false name Greg Halifax. According to UAPGerb, the story was about a man brought into a secret program, called Zodiac, that recovered crashed UFOs, a program he links to TRW, an American defence company, and which the UFO historian Richard Dolan has discussed. If true, it would be an early inside account of the government gathering crashed craft.
